What's new in 0.34.0 — A bigger focused row, and trailers that carry on

• On Home, the row you're on grows, and the poster you're on opens wide with its trailer and a short summary underneath.
• Trailers start sooner, on Home and in Pick for Me, and Pick for Me always plays the trailer for the film it picked.
• Open a film or show while its trailer plays and the trailer carries on from the same moment.
• While a trailer plays on a film's page, the page fades away after a few seconds. Press any button to bring it back.
• Live TV: no more crash when changing channel with subtitles on, and a stream that stalls now moves to another one sooner instead of getting stuck.
